# Pastas & Noodles
There's nothing like a big bowl of noodles.
Pasta needs no dough of its own: pour [color=#a4885c]15u flour[/color], [color=#a4885c]6u egg[/color] and [color=#a4885c]5u olive oil[/color] straight into the microwave and cook that into boiled spaghetti, the base every dish below is built on.
Anything that does start as dough is mixed and shaped by hand - see [textlink="Doughs & Reactions" link="TP14GuideEntryReactions"] and [textlink="Cutting & Utensils" link="TP14GuideEntryUtensils"].
